asymmetric_variables.rule: A missing record / absence of evidence is UNKNOWN for these variables, never a low or negative value. Row 75: only a completed assessment is evidence (and a positive one at low/medium maturity). Row 73: 'where no postings or disclosure exist the value is Unknown, not Reactive'.

systems_posture.numeric_cutoff_reason: A graded strength strictly between 0 and 1 can only be turned into old/new or siloed/integrated with a cutoff; strengths of exactly 1.0 / 0.0 and named labels need none.
systems_posture.note: Rows 63 and 72 are stored separately and never averaged. The two middle cells imply different pilots and are deliberately not ranked against each other.

quality_group.note: Row 29 is outcome (reviews), row 74 is process (certification). When row 29 is not_applicable the group has one applicable member on NEED, so row 74 carries the group alone (full group weight).

confidence.note: Observations below these confidence levels are excluded as unknown (existing evidence-eligibility rule, kept).
